scenes.text: Every phone call, every broadcast, every satellite is passing through you.
If your eyes could see radio waves, the sky would never be dark.
It would glow with thousands of overlapping signals.
Our own transmissions would outshine every star.
We have already filled the sky with light we cannot see.
Follow What If Physics for more.
